description: This file defines the ToDoPresenter class, which manages the lifecycle, state, and interactions of to-do items within a GWT (Google Web Toolkit)-based ToDo application. It handles view updates, event handling, routing, local storage persistence, and filtering of tasks.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter
classes.description: Manages to-do items, updates the UI, handles routing, persistence, and event handling within the GWT ToDo application.

methods.name: ToDoPresenter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the presenter, loads state, sets up routing, event handlers, and data providers.

methods.name: setupHistoryHandler
methods.description: Sets up the handler for URL hash/routing changes.

methods.name: parseRoutingToken
methods.description: Converts URL hash segments into routing enums.

methods.name: updateFilteredList
methods.description: Filters the tasks based on current routing state.

methods.name: updateTaskStatistics
methods.description: Calculates and updates task counts in the view.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a specific task from the list.

methods.name: itemStateChanged
methods.description: Handles task state changes, cleans up empty titles, and updates UI.

methods.name: taskStateChanged
methods.description: Updates filtered list, statistics, and storage after a task change.

methods.name: markAllCompleted
methods.description: Sets all tasks as completed or active.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task from user input.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Serializes and stores tasks in local storage.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads tasks from local storage on startup.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Reference to the view interface implemented for the presenter.

classes.name: View
classes.description: Interface for the view component that interacts with the presenter.

classes.name: ViewEventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling view-triggered events like add, clear, and mark all.
